name: carousel-host.scss
html:
// ── Custom Carousel Shadow DOM host styles ────────────────────────────────────
// Applied INSIDE the <custom-carousel> Shadow Root.
// These supplement carousel.scss (general carousel styles) and internals.scss
// (slide item styles). Rules here override or complement those where Shadow DOM
// isolation requires explicit redeclaration inside the shadow root.

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';

// ── Shadow host ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
:host {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

// ── Carousel viewport override ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The .carousel opacity/transform starts at 0/translateY(32px) per carousel.scss
// and animates to 1/none when .carousel--in-view is added by IntersectionObserver.
// The carouselExtraStyles previously hard-coded `opacity: 1 !important` to
// prevent the fade-in — that is WRONG. Removed. The IntersectionObserver handles it.

// ── Slide wrapper — must not clip content ────────────────────────────────────
.carousel-slide {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  scroll-snap-align: center;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: visible;
}

// ── Slide item container ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// These styles mirror .internal-extra-item from internals.scss but must be
// redeclared here because Shadow DOM isolation prevents the parent's stylesheet
// from styling elements inside <custom-carousel>'s Shadow Root.
.internal-extra-item {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: inline-block;
  width: min-content;
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
  box-sizing: border-box;

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    // Desktop: keep ≥24px of margin on each side of every slide item — the
    // media box inside can never sit closer to its neighbours than
    // padding + 24px, which keeps the "click to open" affordance and the
    // corner borders clear of adjacent slides.
    margin-inline: to-rem(24);
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  // In the carousel context, every item is the sole child of its slide,
  // so :first-of-type/:last-of-type both match — they'd zero-out padding.
  // Restore symmetric gaps between items in the carousel track.
  .carousel & {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-768() {
      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
    }
    @include layout-1920() {
      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-3xl);
      }
      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: to-rem($space-3xl);
      }
    }
  }

  // ── CSS Custom Properties for media-figure Shadow DOM sizing ────────────────
  // internals.scss sets these on <media-figure> in the light DOM, but when
  // <media-figure> is inside <custom-carousel>'s Shadow Root, the light DOM
  // rules can't reach it. We must redeclare the same vars here, inside the
  // carousel Shadow Root, where they can reach nested <media-figure> elements.
  media-figure {
    --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)});
    --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)});
    --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)});

    @include layout-768() {
      --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)});
      --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)});
      --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)});
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-6xl)};
      --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
      --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
      --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-9xl)};
    }
  }

  // landscape variant: --mf-w carries the vw cap (consumed as the
  // placeholder's max-width) so wide media uses most of the viewport;
  // --mf-max-w mirrors it for any max-width consumer.
  &.landscape media-figure {
    @include layout-1024() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)});
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)});
    }

    @include layout-1280() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-7xl)});
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-7xl)});
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-6xl)});
      --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-6xl)});
    }
  }

  // small variant
  &.small media-figure {
    @include layout-1440() {
      --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-6xl)};
      --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
      --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-9xl)};
    }
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
